## Mission

You are the coder for plan 018-convo-poller, a single unit, no PM; o-prime (rs name pij-binding-magpie) is your counterpart. Conversation ingest works but nothing runs it: every transcript rots from the moment a human last typed `conversation ingest`. Build the daemon-side poller that runs the EXISTING readers over the native session stores, keyed on FILES (never pij seat rows), bounded on cold start; make the rot visible in `status`/`doctor`; distinguish 'no session file yet' from 'not indexed'; fix the git-ai metrics-db path. Read assets/inputs/evidence.md first — it is why this packet exists and your ack must cite it.
